steps.note: The milk undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.
The lactase is usually made by yeasts.

steps.name: break down
steps.note: The lactose is split into glucose and galactose by the lactase; at 0.02 % lactase and 40 °C, all of it is split in about 8 h.

processing.text: Valio's milk is made the other way, by filtering out the lactose with membranes and splitting what is left.
